unit.why: A single anecdote: the Vurke rebbe sends a message through R. Isser to the Mogielnica rebbe, who perceives that the matter has gone badly, and later events prove him right.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי כ״פ מהרבני החסיד ר׳ איסר מווארקא
stories.end_quote: רבי שלכם הוא בשמים ואני בארץ
stories.summary_en: Before Rosh Hashanah, the Vurke rebbe sends R. Isser to tell the Mogielnica rebbe that a known matter stands well. The Mogielnica rebbe replies that Vurke was misled and the matter stands very badly, and when this proves true, the Vurke rebbe concedes: 'your rebbe is in heaven and I am on earth.'
